title: What To Do If You Notice an Unauthorized Debit Card Transaction
summary: Explains Rho-Bank steps for debit card disputes if you notice an unauthorized debit card transaction or other listed issues (ATM problems, duplicate charges, incorrect amounts, subscription not canceled, missing purchases). Covers liability by reporting time ($50 within 2 business days, $500 within 60 days, after 60 days may not recover), provisional credit timing (typically within 10 business days), investigation/resolution window (10–45 business days), and contact methods (1-800-RHO-BANK 24/7, mobile app “Report Issue,” rhobank.com/disputes).
faqs: How fast do I need to report an unauthorized debit card transaction to limit my liability?
What’s my maximum liability if I report within 2 business days or within 60 days?
What types of debit card issues does Rho-Bank help investigate and dispute?
When will I receive provisional credit while Rho-Bank investigates?
How long does the investigation take before I get a resolution?
What information and channels do I need to file a debit card dispute, and is a police report needed for fraud over $500?
